prompt: Review an unseen sanitized AIOps system and evidence packet. Defend the operational task, telemetry contract, baselines, detector and forecast evaluation, alert deduplication and incident grouping, probable-cause evidence, explanation and feedback design, security/privacy, capacity/cost, rollout and automation authority. Recover one reviewer-injected false-correlation or harmful-automation incident, prove the bounded user outcome independently, and revise the design after a material topology, workload, label-delay, privacy, review-capacity, action-lead or authority constraint changes.
deliverables: User operation, SLI/SLO, harm, action, abstention, non-AI baseline and explicit non-goals.
Signal semantics, units, temporality, resource identity, all clocks, missingness, collection lineage and quality gates.
Static, seasonal-naive and robust baseline comparison plus justified detector choice and feature contract.
Time-ordered incident-level evaluation with labels, availability delay, simple/random baseline, slices, uncertainty and error costs.
Precision, recall, alert load, review-capacity, compression, forecast horizon/error/interval and action-lead calculations.
Raw alert, normalized identity, stable fingerprint, deduplication, bounded grouping, suppression, routing and must-not-merge proof.
Versioned topology and change evidence, cause candidates, contradictions, confounders, mechanism and safe discriminating test.
Explanation binding and limits plus governed feedback identity, reviewer confidence, correction and delayed outcome.
Threat model, least privilege, untrusted content, supply-chain, privacy classification, minimization, retention, deletion and audit.
AIOps pipeline SLOs, queue/backpressure/admission, drift, fallback, unit cost, version rollback and kill switch.
Typed automation state machine with external policy/approval, idempotency, deadlines/effect budgets, reconciliation and postconditions.
Incident timeline, reversible containment, preserved lineage, recovery proof, changed-constraint defense and exact cleanup.
evidenceRequirements: Reviewer provides unfamiliar synthetic telemetry, labels, incidents, topology, changes, detector/forecast output, grouping, feedback, runtime and action evidence.
No real credential, customer data, shared production service, unrestricted shell/network/admin tool, hidden suppression, unbounded load/action or unknown cleanup.
Every claim binds exact service/resource/version/population and source event, observed and ingest time where relevant.
Evaluation is chronological and incident-aware; the same incident or future-derived transform cannot cross the split.
Simple and appropriate no-skill baselines are compared; point adjustment cannot silently award whole-incident credit.
Alert reduction retains raw lineage and both must-merge and must-not-merge tests.
Correlation and feature attribution remain candidate/model evidence until independent mechanism evidence supports cause.
Forecast uncertainty and horizon are compared with approval, action, validation and safety margin.
Feedback distinguishes incident truth, actionability, grouping, cause, recommendation, execution and user outcome.
Automation remains outside detector authority and proves current-state reconciliation before retry.
Reviewer observes injected-incident recovery, changed-constraint revision, independent user postconditions, delayed recall and cleanup.
